patch_list: Buy any gold pack without paying: each pack grants its gems and its no-ads time (the last pack is permanent), and purchases persist after a restart. No Play payment dialog is shown.
Interstitial ads no longer show, and reward ads pay out instantly — tap the reward button and the coins/gems are granted without watching a video. The "watch ad for gems" button is always available.
